theme_archetype.vibe: Elegant, soft, warm, minimal, romantic, airy
theme_archetype.rationale: A soft cream/blush/sage palette with elegant typography conveys romance and sophistication, avoiding the clinical feel of pure white or the overused dark tech aesthetics.

typography.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl tracking-tight font-light

hero_background.description: Subtle cream blush watercolor texture used as a blended background for the hero section.

ornamental_background.description: Sage eucalyptus leaves, can be used as a subtle accent image or footer background.

hero.layout: Min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-center items-center text-center relative overflow-hidden
hero.visuals: Use the 'hero_background' as an absolute positioned image with object-cover and opacity-30, fading to the base color at the bottom via CSS gradient.
hero.content: Overline 'WE ARE GETTING MARRIED', massive elegant names 'Simran & Sagar' with an ampersand in a different font weight/italic, date 'June 23-25, 2026', and a minimal dynamic countdown timer below.

countdown_timer.logic: Target date: June 23, 2026 00:00:00. Show Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds.
countdown_timer.styling: A horizontal flex row of small glassmorphic or border-only blocks. Very subtle border-sage/20. Numbers in Cormorant Garamond, labels in Outfit uppercase.

event_schedule.layout: Vertical timeline or staggered bento layout.

events.title: Bhog Saheb & Mehendi Night
events.details: Morning Bhog Saheb. Evening Mehendi + DJ Party.
events.location: Our Residence, Manipur Layout, VMV Road, Amravati

events.title: Saath & Ladies Sangeet
events.details: Morning Saath. Evening Ladies Sangeet and Tel Bukhi.

event_schedule.styling: Cards with soft background 'surface' color, 1px subtle border, no heavy drop shadows. Generous padding (p-8 or p-12).

photo_gallery.layout: Masonry or overlapping asymmetrical grid using CSS columns or grid-cols-12.
photo_gallery.styling: Use the 5 user-provided images. Images should have very subtle border-radius (e.g., rounded-md or rounded-xl) to feel elegant. Incorporate parallax scroll effects with framer-motion.

venue_and_contact.layout: Two-column grid (md:grid-cols-2). Left: Maps/Venue, Right: RSVP Contacts.
venue_and_contact.styling: Minimalist map placeholder or embedded iframe with grayscale filter if possible. Elegant phone icons (lucide-react).

libraries: framer-motion (for page transitions and scroll animations)
technical_requirements.installation_commands: yarn add framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge date-fns

animations.scroll: Staggered fade-up for schedule items and gallery images.
animations.hero: Slow, subtle scale-up of the background image. Fade-in for names.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create the site strictly as a React static landing page (no backend).
Ensure the index.css includes the provided font imports and tailwind directives.
Do not use Shadcn 'Card' components if they force strong borders/shadows; build custom elegant divs using the provided color palette.
Inject the design guidelines colors into tailwind.config.js or use inline arbitrary values/custom CSS variables.
ALL interactive elements and key information (countdown, schedule cards, RSVP buttons) MUST have 'data-testid' attributes.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations on scroll. Since it's a wedding site, motion should feel deliberate, slow, and romantic.
Ensure 'Cormorant Garamond' is applied to the main headings (Simran & Sagar) and 'Outfit' for all other text.
DO NOT use generic placeholder images. Map the gallery exactly to the 5 provided URLs.
